scripts.start: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process');const isCI=String(process.env.CI||'').toLowerCase()==='true';if(isCI){console.log('[recipe_frontend] CI detected: redirecting to start:serve to avoid exit code 137.');process.exit(123);}const r=spawnSync('npm',['run','_start:dev'],{stdio:'inherit',shell:true});process.exit(r.status||0);"; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 123 ]; then npm run start:serve; else if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then npm run _start:dev; fi; fi
scripts.start:ci: cross-env BROWSER=none CI=true HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=$REACT_APP_PORT NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=384 GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=${REACT_APP_ENABLE_SOURCE_MAPS:-false} react-scripts start

scripts.healthcheck: node -e "const http=require('http');const port=process.env.REACT_APP_PORT||process.env.PORT||3000;const path=(process.env.REACT_APP_HEALTHCHECK_PATH)||'/';const host='127.0.0.1';const opts={host,port,path,timeout:8000};const req=http.get(opts,res=>{let data='';res.on('data',c=>data+=c);res.on('end',()=>{const okMeta=/(<meta[^>]*name=[\"']x-healthcheck[\"'][^>]*content=[\"']ok[\"'][^>]*>)/i.test(data);const statusOk=res.statusCode===200;console.log(`[healthcheck] status=${res.statusCode} meta=${okMeta?'ok':'missing'}`);process.exit(statusOk?0:1)});});req.on('timeout',()=>{console.error('[healthcheck] timeout');req.destroy();process.exit(1)});req.on('error',e=>{console.error('[healthcheck] error:',e.message);process.exit(1)});"
scripts.prestart: echo "INFO: In CI, 'npm run start:serve' is preferred to avoid exit code 137 (watch server). 'npm start' will auto-redirect when CI=true."
